easyPrerequisites:
The One Ring is exiled by Myr Welder.
You have either {1}, a burden counter on Myr Welder or an additional card in hand.
description:
Activate Myr Welder using The One Ring's ability by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder
Repeat
